saw_lines: Dog owners rarely buy supplements on impulse. They buy when something is wrong, then reorder the same pack.
So the sale is won in the first line, when an owner recognizes the problem and decides to try it.
Your 22 of 30 ads open on the same “viele hunde leiden still unter” line, so write two openers for Fresh Smile Topping and Happy Tummy and test each against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: 22 of your 30 ads open on the same line, “viele hunde leiden still unter”, so one story keeps reaching the same owners. Write two openers around Fresh Smile Topping and Happy Tummy, and test each against it.

15 of your 30 ads run one identical dental copy for Fresh Smile Topping, so the same words reach the same owners in several placements. Keep the copy, but give each version a new opening line and visual.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.
0 of your 30 ads mention an offer or discount, so new buyers get no reason to act today. Make a first order offer or a bundle the opening line of three new ads and show the saving on the creative.

ads_1: New openers for Fresh Smile Topping and Happy Tummy, with a first order offer
